after.prompt: outputs/agents/vani_after.txt: the same rendered VANI prompt + the Cowork-approved C3 rule (Collection Control) + a 3-ask cap line in Location Collection Principles (76,098 chars)

only_difference: Two added lines, nothing removed. (1) Collection Control: 'A reworded, rephrased, or example-filled version of a field question is the same question, not a new one: it counts against that field's existing ask limit and never resets or extends it. Once a field's limit is reached, do not rephrase, reopen, or re-ask it, close it as exhausted and move on.' (2) Location Collection Principles: 'Location follows Collection Control: city and state together may be requested at most 3 times in total, counting every rephrasing... If the buyer still has not given a usable city after the third request, stop asking, say the seller will confirm the location directly, mark location as exhausted and move to FINALISATION. A missing location never blocks closing.'
